questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you that you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. Be alert and prepare to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road splits into two directions, and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (12 feet, 6 inches in this example).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes traveling in the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs always mean "Stop." Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. Orange color is used on warning signs in construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow, pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will change direction or become narrower. You may see it before sharp curves or narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red, octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic or pedestrians, and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You will often see it at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on the back of vehicles traveling slower than 25 mph, such as farm equipment, construction machinery, or horse-drawn vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs always mean a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve right and then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid collisions and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services ahead. These include rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful facilities.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk or intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic will merge ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you to slow down for a sharp turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic will merge from the right side ahead.
